author: deepseek-3.2
brief: Phase: implementation (a feature in existing code). Role: developer. Repo kind: a Python 3.12 JSON API on the standard library (http.server and sqlite3) for a ticketing tool, with a router, a repository layer, handlers, tests, CI config and docs. About 25 files. Inspiration (idea only): public REST frameworks that offer cursor pagination: an opaque cursor, stable ordering, a next link, and a page size limit. Build a task where the owner asks to replace offset paging on the list endpoint with cursor paging while old clients keep working for a release, with wrinkles of your own design (ties on the sort key, rows inserted or deleted between pages, an opaque cursor that rejects tampering, a maximum page size, and a response shape documented in the existing API doc).
